rule.vendored: unchanged Longfellow d5e6be77 file under third_party/longfellow; header unchanged
rule.modified: Longfellow file we changed; Google notice as upstream has it plus a "Modified 2026 by Chad Sharp and Paul Grubbs" line (Apache-2.0 4(b))
rule.derived: new file copying substantial code from upstream_source; that file's Google notice plus the Modified line
rule.ours: our file; "Copyright 2026 Chad Sharp and Paul Grubbs" and "SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0"
rule.third-party: vendored XKCP subset (lib/third_party/xkcp/upstream and its copy in comparisons/longfellow/baselines/common-wide); CC0 or CRYPTOGAMS headers unchanged

notice_file: none: Longfellow ships no NOTICE file at d5e6be77, so Apache-2.0 4(d) adds no obligation
out_of_scope: data files (.json, .inc, .patch, .md, .lean, logs, results), provenance/, comparisons/longfellow/upstream (submodule)
